test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Come to blows
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e. “****Get into a fight physically.”**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let’s look at the **meaning **of the given** idiom/ phrase:**

 
 
• The phrase **‘****Come to blows’ means to have a physical fight or a serious argument with someone.**
 
 
 
• ***Example***:
 
 
• *​India and Pakistan will **come to blows** over the Kashmir issue.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is **option 3 ‘****Get into a fight physically****’**, which exactly resembles the **meaning **of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

**Correct meaning:**__ *Get into a fight physically.*
